tei:titleStmt.tei:title: אהבה לשבת לפני שבעות
Ahavah piyyuṭ for the Shabbat before Shavuot by Yitsḥaq ben Reuven Albargeloni

tei:div.tei:head: Ahavah piyyuṭ for the Shabbat before Shavuot by Yitsḥaq ben Reuven Albargeloni

tei:lg.tei:l: My amazing one,
ibex of grace, dove, why do you weep?
Your anointed will come to you, get up, get going!
For I am your Savior and Redeemer for whom you hope.
and now, seeing that I am a Redeemer... (Ruth 3:12)
...My amazing one.
My Mighty One,
still those waiting who waited for the engraved prophecy,
to call to the abandoned one who is cast out today,
to again be desired and wanted,
as Yours is the law of redemption and inheritance... (Cf. Jeremiah 32:7)
...my Mighty One.
My amazing one,
amazingly beautiful, I have desired you in My sight,
as I passed upon you as I cut My covenant,
and I will again gather you to My house of rest,
to the place that I have established... (Exodus 23:20)
...My amazing one.
My Mighty One,
came close, the trusted messenger, gave sound wisdom,
and commanded me to be pure and clean.
If You guard me and if You don’t send me into exile,
when it was revealed to us, so it was... (Genesis 41:13)
...my Mighty One.
My amazing one,
studied in affliction’s furnace, locked in the enclosure.
once again will you adorn your adornments in praise-hymns.
A splendid diadem which is your perfect adornment;
Better that I give her to you... (Genesis 29:19)
...My amazing one.
My Mighty One,
noble was I, adorned with all splendor,
oh, my children left me, and their descendants’ remnant
fell in a deep pit’s darkness, and I have none to enlighten,
and the stone was great over the well’s mouth... (Genesis 29:2)
...my Mighty One.
My amazing one,
retreat, my dear, from between the hands of stressors
enticing you with enciting words.
unwilling am I to chase after strangers,
nor go after the young men... (Ruth 3:10)
...My amazing one.
My Mighty One,
vexations have bound me in exile,
enticed me with their vanities and oppressed me mightily,
to abandon Your name and Your testified visions.
O, Cause my God, if I have done so! (Psalms 7:4)
...my Mighty One.
My amazing one,
Now by Me I have sworn to gather My captives;
is it not so that kings will offer tribute to you?
Lo, until I have set nations for My holy ones,
Behold, I have seen a son for Jesse! (I Samuel 16:18)
...My amazing one.
And draw us near to Your great name, selah, in truth,
to thank You and unify You in love.
Blessed are You, Cause, who chooses Their people Israel in love.

tei:note.tei:p: i.e. Israel. This is a conversation poem between Israel and God.
